player_prompt.intro:
A xɔ ɖo xó dó {num_buttons} knonnin: {buttons}. Òjò knonnin ɖɔ lɛ̀ Bernoulli tɛ̀tɛ̀ ɖɔ̀ wɛ̀ azɔ̀n wɛ̀ mɛ̀nɖɛ̀; azɔ̀n wɛ̀ mɛ̀nɖɛ̀ na knonnin lɛ̀ ɖɔ̀ kɛ̀nɖɛ̀.
Gbɔ̀ knonnin ɖɔ̀, ɖɔ̀ wɛ̀ a xɔ̀ ɖɔ̀, a na xɔ̀ ɖɔ̀nɖɛ̀n tɛ̀tɛ̀ ɖɔ̀ wɛ̀ a xɔ̀ ɖɔ̀.
A xɔ̀ {num_turns} ganhi lɛ̀, bɔ̀ ganhi ɖɔ̀, a xɔ̀ knonnin kɛ̀nɖɛ̀ ɖɔ̀ wɛ̀ a na xɔ̀ ɖɔ̀nɖɛ̀n tɛ̀tɛ̀ ɖɔ̀.
A ɖɔ̀jɛ̀ ɖɔ̀ wɛ̀ a xɔ̀ knonnin lɛ̀ ɖɔ̀ ganhi ɖɔ̀ wɛ̀ a xɔ̀ ɖɔ̀nɖɛ̀n tɛ̀tɛ̀ ɖɔ̀ wɛ̀ a na xɔ̀ knonnin ɖɔ̀ wɛ̀ azɔ̀n wɛ̀ mɛ̀nɖɛ̀ kɛ̀nɖɛ̀ {num_turns} ganhi ɖɔ̀.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Akɔɖanú ɔ́ yí gbe nú xó ɖɔ wɛ è ɖè ǎ.
invalid_move.invalid_button: È sɔ́ nùɖé ɖó wuntun ɖé mɛ̀.

game_action.pressed: È wɔ̀n ṣɛ́ bọ́tɔ̀n {button}, bo ṣɛ́ mɛ̀ ɖɛ̀ wɔ̀n na ɖɔ̀nɔ̀ {reward}.

game_message.final_decision: A sɔ́ akwɛ e a zán dó ba nǔ vovo lɛ kpɔ́n bo nɔ gbéjé lè yetɔn lɛ é bǐ, dìn ɔ, wá gbeta ɖé kɔn ɖɔ ali ɖagbe tɛ jí wɛ a na gbɔn.

outcome.win: Un dó kú nú we! A sɔ́ gǒjíblánú e sɔgbe é.
outcome.lose: A sɔ́ ɖyɔ̌vi e ma sɔgbe ǎ é.
